claim: Replacing ruvector-mincut::wrapper::MinCutWrapper's DynamicConnectivity backend with PolylogConnectivity (an explicit, selectable ConnectivityBackend, baseline default unchanged) improves RuVectorGraphAnalyzer::partition() wall-clock latency and/or its scaling exponent with graph size, while preserving correctness and existing test suites.
independent_variable: ConnectivityBackend (EulerTour baseline vs. Polylog), held as the only intentional difference between paired runs against the same DynamicGraph instance.

datasets.name: synthetic_random_connected_graphs
datasets.source: crates/ruvector-mincut/examples/connectivity_backend_partition_probe.rs (StdRng-seeded spanning-path + random extra edges, generated in-process, not downloaded)
datasets.sha256: not_applicable: procedurally generated from a fixed seed list, not a static file; the generator function itself is the reproducibility artifact
datasets.sampling: deterministic given seed; seeds [11,22,33,44,55] per graph size except n=19 (seed 11 only, documented exception)

datasets.name: mincut_gated_forgetting_corpus
datasets.source: crates/ruvector-agent-memory/examples/mincut_gated_forgetting_bench.rs (synthetic 6-cluster + bridge corpus, StdRng seed=341, unchanged from the 2026-09-05/2026-09-11 nightlies)
datasets.sha256: not_applicable: procedurally generated, not a static file
datasets.sampling: deterministic given seed=341, reused unmodified from prior nightlies

embedding_space.reason: This experiment is a graph-algorithm latency/correctness study over ruvector-mincut's connectivity backend; it has no embedding space, no vector retrieval, and no ADR-281 EmbeddingSpaceIdentity applies.

topology.claimed: ruvector-mincut production path: RuVectorGraphAnalyzer -> MinCutWrapper -> BoundedInstance (real, in-tree, unmodified cut-search algorithms)
topology.implemented: identical production path; only MinCutWrapper's internal conn_ds field type changed (DynamicConnectivity -> ConnectivityStructure enum wrapping either backend), with the default (EulerTour) behaviorally identical to pre-existing code

configuration.graph_generator: spanning-path (guarantees connectivity) + k*n/2 random extra edges, k=8

root_cause.evidence: ad hoc instrumentation of MinCutWrapper::process_instances, not committed; log excerpts retained in README.md

metrics.decision_rationale: No graph size shows a mean difference exceeding the other backend's own standard deviation; n=100 shows Polylog nominally faster, confirming no systematic direction. Root-cause code-path analysis independently confirms the connectivity backend is outside BoundedInstance's cut-search call graph.

memory_accounting.reason: No memory-budget claim is made; this is a latency/correctness claim. ConnectivityStructure adds only an enum discriminant around the pre-existing backend structs.
